image.alt: Countertop installation in the Central Valley: long gray and white granite island with an undermount sink in a white shaker kitchen

intro.h2: Stone Counters Cut and Set by the Same Crew
paragraphs: AML Stoneworks Countertops handles countertop installation across the Central Valley and the Bay Area, working from pre-fabricated pieces or full slabs. Owner Alfonso Molina comes out to take the measurements and gives you a bid before any stone is cut.

The work goes beyond a single counter. Blanca T. had her kitchen remodeled and her outdoor kitchen started. Their photos show long granite islands and white veined stone carried up the wall as a full-height backsplash. James L. says Alfonso is a true professional when it comes to counters and installation, and that the bid was reasonable. Estimates are free, and you can call or text to set one up.

services.h2: Countertop Installation and Stone Work in the Central Valley

items.name: Granite, marble and quartz countertops
items.blurb: Kitchen and bathroom counters in granite, marble or quartz, fabricated and installed. AML works from pre-fabricated pieces or full slabs and takes on big islands too: one Facebook post describes a large top as one heavy piece that turned out very nice.

image.alt: Kitchen with speckled granite countertops and a full granite backsplash, a black undermount sink and a large picture window

items.name: Full-height backsplashes
items.blurb: Stone carried from the counter up the wall for a clean backsplash with no grout lines. Several kitchens in their photos use a bright white stone with gray and gold veining on both the counters and the full wall behind the range and sink.

image.alt: White kitchen with veined white countertops and a matching full-height stone backsplash during installation

items.name: Kitchen remodels
items.blurb: When the counters are part of a bigger change, AML helps with the wider kitchen remodel. One before and after on their Google profile shows a kitchen going from honey oak cabinets and tile to gray shaker cabinets, a white island and marble-look counters.

image.alt: Before and after of a kitchen: oak cabinets and tile floor replaced with gray cabinets, a marble-look backsplash and plank floors

items.name: Outdoor kitchens
items.blurb: Granite tops for outdoor kitchens and barbecue counters built on block bases. Blanca T. wrote that Alfonso brought her one step closer to completing her outdoor kitchen, and their photos show white and gray granite set on a new block counter.

image.alt: Outdoor kitchen block base topped with white and gray granite countertops on a concrete patio

items.name: Showers, floors and walls
items.blurb: Granite, marble, quartz, stacked stone and tile are not just for counters. AML also installs stone and tile in showers, on floors and on walls, as their business card and Facebook page say. Ask about your bathroom when they come out for the estimate.

items.title: Fabrication and installation in one place
items.text: Their business card says it plainly: fabrication and installation. The stone and the install come from the same company, whether the job uses pre-fabricated pieces or full slabs.

items.title: Free estimates, call or text
items.text: AML offers free estimates and you can call or text to schedule one. James L. says Alfonso came out to measure and gave him a reasonable bid.

items.title: Easy to book, done on time
items.text: Blanca T. wrote that it was easy to set up an appointment and everything was done on time, from the indoor kitchen to the start of her outdoor kitchen.

items.title: Open seven days
items.text: Hours run Monday to Thursday 8 AM to 6 PM and Friday through Sunday 9 AM to 5 PM, so you can call or text with questions on the weekend too.

about.h2: About Alfonso Molina and AML Stoneworks
about.text: AML Stoneworks Countertops is run by Alfonso Molina, whose name is on the company business card along with countertops, backsplashes, showers and floors. The company fabricates and installs natural stone and quartz, and serves the whole Central Valley and the Bay Area. Customers say Alfonso came out to measure himself and gave a reasonable bid, and he answers his Google reviews, thanking customers by name. Beyond full installs, AML keeps stone remnants on hand and ready to sell, which can suit a smaller project like a vanity.

image.alt: Large kitchen with natural wood cabinets and a big island with a dark stone top and four bar stools

steps.title: Call or text
steps.text: Call or text (209) 622-7884 to schedule your free estimate. Appointments are easy to set up, according to a reviewer.

steps.title: Measure and bid
steps.text: Alfonso comes out to take measurements, talks through stone choices and gives you a bid for the job.

steps.title: Fabrication
steps.text: Your granite, marble or quartz is cut and finished to the measurements, whether from a pre-fabricated piece or a full slab.

steps.title: Installation
steps.text: The crew sets the counters, backsplash and sink cutouts, and checks the fit and seams before leaving.

service_area.h2: Serving the Central Valley and the Bay Area
service_area.text: AML Stoneworks says it serves all of the Central Valley and the Bay Area, and no showroom address is listed. The work they share includes indoor kitchens, a full-height backsplash and an outdoor kitchen. If you are not sure whether your home is in range, call or text (209) 622-7884 with your city and a quick description of the counters you need.

items.a: Yes. AML Stoneworks offers free estimates and invites homeowners to call or text to schedule one. Alfonso comes out to take measurements and then gives you a bid, so you know the price before any stone is cut. Have your sink and range models handy if they are changing.

Granite, marble, quartz, stacked stone and tile. AML installs natural stone from pre-fabricated pieces or full slabs, and uses these materials for countertops, backsplashes, showers, floors and walls. If you have a material in mind that is not listed here, ask at the estimate.

items.q: Do you sell remnants for small projects?
items.a: Yes. AML has posted that it keeps remnants on hand, ready to be sold, with prices starting at $25 and up as of May 2023. Remnants can be a good fit for bathroom vanities, small tops or outdoor pieces. Call to ask what is in stock now and what sizes are available.

AML Stoneworks serves the whole Central Valley and the Bay Area. There is no showroom address listed, so the best first step is to call or text (209) 622-7884 with your city and a short description of your project, then set up a time for the free estimate and measurements.

Monday to Thursday from 8 AM to 6 PM, and Friday, Saturday and Sunday from 9 AM to 5 PM. That means you can reach AML seven days a week, including weekends, to ask a question about stone or to set up your free estimate.

final_cta.text: Call or text Alfonso for a free estimate on your countertop installation in the Central Valley or Bay Area.
